title: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)
As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees
As a data engineer, I can pull customer data in from third-party cloud apps and feeds — not just my own instrumented apps
As a data engineer, anonymous and known activity stitches into one customer profile across devices, with documented and configurable identity-resolution rules
As a data engineer, I can query unified customer profiles — traits, identifiers, event history — through a documented profile API or store
As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating
As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting
As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time
As a data engineer, I can route events to a large catalog of documented destination integrations with per-destination mapping and filtering
As a data engineer, raw events and profiles land in my own warehouse or lake (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3) on a schedule I control
As a data engineer, I can run warehouse-native: define models and audiences on tables already in my warehouse and activate them without re-collecting the data (reverse ETL)
As a data engineer, I can transform, filter, and enrich events in-pipeline with custom code or functions before they reach destinations
As a data engineer, a tracking plan or schema is enforced — violating events get flagged, blocked, or quarantined instead of silently corrupting downstream data
As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically
As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes
As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations
As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting
As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks
As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server
As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop
As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema
As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
